name: athena-partition-doctor
description: Enumerates Amazon Glue tables, flags unpartitioned tables over log-shaped S3 prefixes, correlates them with recent high-ProcessedBytes Athena queries, and emits ready-to-run partition-projection DDL plus an optional partitioned-CTAS reorg and Parquet-conversion recommendation, quantifying the projected bytes-scanned reduction. Read-only and recommend-only. Distinct from general query tuning and scan-limit governance; this is the automated partition-projection-DDL emit angle. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on WED at 05:00 UTC
